title: HSK 3.17 · 推进, 增长, 丰富, 志愿者
focus: 啤酒 · 举办 · 环 · 双方 · 离婚 · 吵 · 丰富 · 温暖 · 齐 · 领先 · 围 · 较 · 福 · 补 · 愿望 · 长期 · 富 · 先进 · 西部 · 改造 · 增长 · 部长 · 推进 · 修改 · 带领 · 补充 · 生长 · 改进 · 环保 · 读者 · 吵架 · 南部 · 另一方面 · 东部 · 推动 · 北部 · 志愿者 · 推广 · 面积 · 办理
body:
This lesson is full of direction and progress words: 部 "part" turns compass points into regions (东部, 西部…), while 推, 进 and 改 build verbs of pushing forward and changing. 长 shows up in both of its readings.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 部 | bù | part, section, department | 西部, 南部, 东部, 北部, 部长 |
| 长 | zhǎng / cháng | grow, head / long | 增长, 部长, 生长, 长期 |
| 推 | tuī | push (扌 hand + 隹 phonetic) | 推进, 推动, 推广 |
| 进 | jìn | advance, enter | 先进, 推进, 改进 |
| 改 | gǎi | change | 改造, 修改, 改进 |
| 补 | bǔ | patch, make up (衤 clothing + 卜) | 补, 补充 |
| 领 | lǐng | lead, collar | 领先, 带领 |
| 富 | fù | rich | 富, 丰富 |

## Watch out

- 长 is **zhǎng** (grow, head) in 增长, 生长, 部长, but **cháng** (long) in 长期.
- 福 has 礻 (spirit/altar) on the left; 补 has 衤 (clothing), with one extra stroke.

cards.Example: 我们喝一杯啤酒吧。 wǒmen hē yì bēi píjiǔ ba: let's have a beer
cards.Notes: 啤 = 口 + 卑 bēi for the sound (loanword for 'beer') + 酒 alcohol (氵 liquid + 酉 wine jar)

cards.Example: 学校要举办运动会。 xuéxiào yào jǔbàn yùndònghuì: the school will hold a sports meet
cards.Notes: 举 raise, put on + 办 do, handle = put on an event, host it

cards.Example: 她戴着一个耳环。 tā dàizhe yí ge ěrhuán: she is wearing an earring
cards.Notes: 环 = 王 (jade 玉 radical) + 不 (simplified sound part, as in 还 huán): a jade ring

cards.Example: 双方都同意了。 shuāngfāng dōu tóngyì le: both sides agreed
cards.Notes: 双 pair (two 又 hands side by side) + 方 side = both sides

cards.Example: 他们去年离婚了。 tāmen qùnián líhūn le: they divorced last year
cards.Notes: 离 leave, separate + 婚 marriage (女 woman + 昏 hūn for sound) = leave the marriage

cards.Example: 外面太吵了。 wàimiàn tài chǎo le: it's too noisy outside
cards.Notes: 吵 = 口 mouth + 少 shǎo for the sound: noise from mouths

cards.Example: 这里的水果很丰富。 zhèlǐ de shuǐguǒ hěn fēngfù: fruit is plentiful here
cards.Notes: 丰 abundant + 富 rich = rich in variety (not money-rich; that's 有钱)

cards.Example: 他的话很温暖。 tā de huà hěn wēnnuǎn: his words are warm
cards.Notes: 温 warm (氵 water) + 暖 warm (日 sun + 爰 phonetic) = warm, often emotionally

cards.Example: 人都到齐了。 rén dōu dào qí le: everyone is here
cards.Notes: 齐 depicts ears of grain growing level, so 'even, all together'; as in 整齐 tidy, 一齐 together

cards.Example: 我们队领先两分。 wǒmen duì lǐngxiān liǎng fēn: our team leads by two
cards.Notes: 领 lead (页 head + 令 lìng phonetic) + 先 first = lead in front

cards.Example: 大家围着桌子坐。 dàjiā wéizhe zhuōzi zuò: everyone sits around the table
cards.Notes: 围 = 囗 enclosure + 韦 wéi for the sound: enclose all around

cards.Example: 这个比较便宜。 zhège bǐjiào piányi: this one is relatively cheap
cards.Notes: 较 = 车 vehicle + 交 jiāo for the sound; mostly seen in 比较 compare

cards.Example: 祝你幸福！ zhù nǐ xìngfú: I wish you happiness
cards.Notes: 福 = 礻 spirit/altar + 畐 fú (a full jar) for sound: blessings from the gods; don't confuse 礻 with 衤

cards.Meaning: to patch, mend; make up for
cards.Example: 我明天补课。 wǒ míngtiān bǔkè: I'll make up the class tomorrow
cards.Notes: 补 = 衤 clothing + 卜 bǔ for the sound: patch clothes, so fill a gap

cards.Example: 你的愿望是什么？ nǐ de yuànwàng shì shénme: what's your wish?
cards.Notes: 愿 wish (心 heart + 原 yuán phonetic) + 望 hope, look toward = a wish

cards.Example: 他长期住在国外。 tā chángqī zhù zài guówài: he's lived abroad long-term
cards.Notes: 长 cháng long + 期 period = a long period

cards.Example: 他家很富。 tā jiā hěn fù: his family is rich
cards.Notes: 富 = 宀 roof + 畐 fú (a full jar) for sound: a full house, so wealthy

cards.Example: 这台机器很先进。 zhè tái jīqì hěn xiānjìn: this machine is advanced
cards.Notes: 先 first + 进 advance = advanced ahead of others

cards.Example: 他住在西部。 tā zhù zài xībù: he lives in the west
cards.Notes: 西 west + 部 part = western region

cards.Example: 这个老房子改造了。 zhège lǎo fángzi gǎizào le: this old house was remodeled
cards.Notes: 改 change + 造 make, build = rebuild into something new

cards.Example: 收入增长很快。 shōurù zēngzhǎng hěn kuài: income is growing fast
cards.Notes: 增 add (土 + 曾 zēng phonetic) + 长 zhǎng grow = grow in number

cards.Example: 部长明天来。 bùzhǎng míngtiān lái: the minister comes tomorrow
cards.Notes: 部 department + 长 zhǎng head = head of a department, minister

cards.Example: 工作推进得很顺利。 gōngzuò tuījìn de hěn shùnlì: the work is moving smoothly
cards.Notes: 推 push + 进 forward = push ahead (a project)

cards.Example: 请修改一下。 qǐng xiūgǎi yíxià: please revise it
cards.Notes: 修 repair, fix + 改 change = revise

cards.Example: 老师带领我们参观。 lǎoshī dàilǐng wǒmen cānguān: the teacher led our visit
cards.Notes: 带 take along + 领 lead = lead a group

cards.Example: 我补充一点。 wǒ bǔchōng yì diǎn: let me add one point
cards.Notes: 补 make up + 充 fill = fill in what's missing

cards.Example: 小树生长得很快。 xiǎo shù shēngzhǎng de hěn kuài: the sapling grows fast
cards.Notes: 生 live, be born + 长 zhǎng grow = grow (of plants, kids)

cards.Example: 我们还要改进。 wǒmen hái yào gǎijìn: we still need to improve
cards.Notes: 改 change + 进 advance = change for the better

cards.Example: 这个袋子很环保。 zhège dàizi hěn huánbǎo: this bag is eco-friendly
cards.Notes: short for 环境保护: 环(境) environment + 保(护) protect

cards.Example: 这本书读者很多。 zhè běn shū dúzhě hěn duō: this book has many readers
cards.Notes: 读 read + 者 person who = reader

cards.Example: 他们又吵架了。 tāmen yòu chǎojià le: they argued again
cards.Notes: 吵 noisy, quarrel + 架 fight (as in 打架) = have a row

cards.Example: 南部比较热。 nánbù bǐjiào rè: the south is hotter
cards.Notes: 南 south + 部 part = southern region

cards.Example: 另一方面，太贵了。 lìng yì fāngmiàn, tài guì le: on the other hand, it's too expensive
cards.Notes: 另 other + 一方面 one aspect (方 side + 面 face) = the other side of it

cards.Example: 东部城市很多。 dōngbù chéngshì hěn duō: the east has many cities
cards.Notes: 东 east + 部 part = eastern region

cards.Example: 这件事推动了改革。 zhè jiàn shì tuīdòng le gǎigé: this pushed reform forward
cards.Notes: 推 push + 动 move = push into motion

cards.Example: 北部冬天很冷。 běibù dōngtiān hěn lěng: the north is cold in winter
cards.Notes: 北 north + 部 part = northern region

cards.Example: 她是志愿者。 tā shì zhìyuànzhě: she is a volunteer
cards.Notes: 志 will, aim + 愿 wish + 者 person = someone acting by their own will

cards.Example: 我们要推广普通话。 wǒmen yào tuīguǎng pǔtōnghuà: we should promote Mandarin
cards.Notes: 推 push + 广 wide = push out widely

cards.Example: 房子面积多大？ fángzi miànjī duō dà: how big is the flat?
cards.Notes: 面 surface + 积 accumulate (禾 grain + phonetic) = total surface, area

cards.Example: 我去银行办理手续。 wǒ qù yínháng bànlǐ shǒuxù: I'm going to the bank to sort paperwork
cards.Notes: 办 handle + 理 manage, put in order = process, go through formalities
